data.title: Super Strategy Math Lab!
data.description: Master adding numbers up to 10 by discovering fun tricks like counting on, using doubles, and making ten.

challenges.instruction: You solved 3 + 3 two ways: using tally marks and doubles. Both ways give us the same answer, 6!
challenges.comparisonQuestion: Which way was faster for you to figure out?

challenges.instruction: You solved 3 + 3 two different ways! First, you used counting-on (saying 3, then 4, 5, 6). Next, you used a doubles fact (since 3 and 3 make 6). Both ways give you the exact same answer of 6.
challenges.comparisonQuestion: Which strategy felt easier for your brain today?

challenges.instruction: You solved 5 + 5 two ways! You used a doubles fact (5 + 5) and you made a ten. Both ways give you the same answer: 10!
challenges.comparisonQuestion: Which way was faster for your brain today?

challenges.instruction: You solved 1 + 1 in two cool ways: counting-on and using doubles!
challenges.comparisonQuestion: Which strategy felt easier for your brain today?
